items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: so the Shah went from John to me to Jackson to Connie down the line congratulating us

ctx.x: Oh, we were invited to play at the State Department dinner when Richard Nixon was president. We weren’t there just to entertain, we were invited to be guests at the dinner and then perform. So, we had this introduction, when the person introduces you to the president, “This is Mr. Percy Heath,” and Nicky, Mr. Nixon says, “Oh yes, Mr. Heath,” and he tells Agnew, “This is Mr. Percy Heath,” and you’re passed down this receiving line of protocol. We were in this little blue room and we stepped off this little stage…
